forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {捩|ね}じっていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To turn or rotate something with force, often in opposite directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捩|ね}じって→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧。
examples.english: I twist the towel to wring out the water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捩|ね}じって→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: I twisted my body and threw the ball.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捩|ね}じって→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: I twist open the cap of the plastic bottle.

notes:
⟦{捩|ね}じる→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧ means to twist something with rotational force.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{捩|ね}じ→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧れる (intransitive, to become twisted)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捩|ね}じる→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧: to twist someone's arm
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捩|ね}じる→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧: to twist one's body
- ⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捩|ね}じる→捩じる：03937_nejiru⟧: to twist a lid/cap

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to turn, rotate
- ひ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧る: to twist (lighter touch)
- ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to wring, squeeze
